resources.string: %1$s blocked for %2$s. Tap your phone on the tag to unlock.
Tap your phone on the tag to block your apps.
Tag paired. This is your brick now.
That tag changes its ID on every tap, so it can\'t be a brick. Use an NTAG sticker or card.
Choose some apps to block first.
App blocking is switched off, so nothing would be blocked. Turn it on below first.
This phone has no NFC, so it can\'t read a tag.
NFC is off. Turn it on so the phone can read your tag.
Hold the back of your phone against your tag to pair it.
Choose the apps that get blocked while you\'re bricked.
Turn on Brick under Accessibility so it can cover blocked apps. It only sees which app is on screen, never what\'s in it.
App blocking has been switched off, so nothing is being blocked. Turn Brick back on under Accessibility.
Covers the apps you chose with a lock screen while you\'re bricked. Brick is told which app comes to the front and nothing else: it cannot read the screen or what you type.
Also blocks Settings and uninstalling apps while bricked, so Brick can\'t simply be switched off.
Unbrick without the tag? This uses up an emergency unlock and leaves you with %d.
Forget the paired tag? The next tag you tap becomes the brick.
Tap your phone on the tag to unlock.
